description: This file implements the 'git notes' builtin commands for the Git version control system. It includes functions for listing, adding, copying, editing, showing, merging, removing, and pruning notes associated with Git objects, as well as managing references to the notes. The source code handles command-line argument parsing, interacts with Git repositories and objects, and manages note data storage and conflict resolution.

classes.name: note_msg
classes.description: Represents a note message, including whether to strip whitespace and the message buffer.

classes.name: note_data
classes.description: Holds data related to a note being edited or added, including editor usage, whitespace handling, editing path, buffers, and messages.

methods.name: void free_note_data(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a note_data structure, including unlinking temporary files and releasing buffers.

methods.name: int list_each_note(const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,char * note_path UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Callback function to list each note-object pair in the repository.

methods.name: void copy_obj_to_fd(int fd,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads an object from the object database and writes its content to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void write_commented_object(int fd,const struct object_id * object)
methods.description: Invokes 'git show' on an object and writes its output as commented lines to a file descriptor.

methods.name: void prepare_note_data(const struct object_id * object,struct note_data * d,const struct object_id * old_note)
methods.description: Prepares note data for editing, including writing templates, copying existing notes, and invoking an editor if needed.

methods.name: void write_note_data(struct note_data * d,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Writes the note buffer to the object database as a blob object.

methods.name: void append_separator(struct strbuf * message)
methods.description: Appends a separator (e.g., newline) to a message buffer.

methods.name: void concat_messages(struct note_data * d)
methods.description: Concatenates multiple message buffers into a single note buffer, managing whitespace based on user preferences.

methods.name: int parse_msg_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a message argument for note content and stores it in note_data.

methods.name: int parse_file_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a file argument for note content, reading the file into the message buffer.

methods.name: int parse_reuse_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Loads an existing note object into the message buffer for reuse.

methods.name: int parse_reedit_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Flags that note content should be edited (reuse and edit).

methods.name: int parse_separator_arg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets or clears the separator string used between note paragraphs.

methods.name: int notes_copy_from_stdin(int force,const char * rewrite_cmd)
methods.description: Copies notes for multiple objects from stdin input, supporting batch operations.

methods.name: struct:notes_tree * init_notes_check(const char * subcommand,int flags)
methods.description: Initializes notes context ensuring it is within the refs/notes namespace.

methods.name: int list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists notes for objects, either all or for a specific object.

methods.name: int add(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Adds or updates a note for a specified object, with support for editing and conflict handling.

methods.name: int copy(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another, with options for force overwrite and stdin input.

methods.name: int append_edit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs editing (or appending) of notes attached to objects.

methods.name: int show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays the note attached to an object.

methods.name: int merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge, cleaning up refs and worktrees.

methods.name: int merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by creating a commit with the merged notes.

methods.name: int git_config_get_notes_strategy(const char * key,enum notes_merge_strategy * strategy)
methods.description: Retrieves merge strategy configuration for notes from git config.

methods.name: int merge(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs merging of notes from a remote ref into the current notes, supporting merge, commit, and abort operations.

methods.name: int remove_one_note(struct notes_tree * t,const char * name,unsigned flag)
methods.description: Removes a note for a specific object, with error handling for missing notes.

methods.name: int remove_cmd(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Removes notes for specified objects, reading from command-line arguments or stdin.

methods.name: int prune(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Prunes unreferenced notes, with options for dry run and verbose reporting.

methods.name: int get_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs the current notes reference/ref-storage path.

methods.name: int cmd_notes(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main entry point for 'git notes' command, parsing subcommands and options, and dispatching to appropriate handlers.
